503
Tourism Development (MCE Sounds Limited) Order
SAINT LUCIA
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT, 2025, No. 124
[ 1st September, 2025 ]
In exercise of the power conferred under sections 81(a), 83(1)
and 86(1)(a) of the Tourism Development Act, No. 1 of 2024, the
Minister responsible for tourism makes this Order:
Citation
1. This Order may be cited as the Tourism Development (MCE
Sounds Limited) Order, 2025.
Approved tourism investment
2. The procurement of specialized equipment and articles by MCE
Sounds Limited is declared an approved tourism investment.
Declared benefit with regard to import duty and excise tax
3.—(1) Subject to subsection (2), the declared benefits for the
approved tourism investment with regard to import duty and excise
tax are —
(a) a one hundred per cent waiver of import duty on stage
and production equipment;
(b) a one hundred per cent waiver of excise tax on stage
and production equipment.
(2) The declared benefits under subsection (1) are —
(a) applicable for a period of one year commencing from the
1st day of May, 2025 and terminating on the 30th day of
April, 2026;
(b) subject to the conditions that the management of MCE Sounds
Limited —
(i) submits to the Ministry of Tourism, Investment,
Creative Industries, Culture and Information a project
completion report within thirty days of the procurement
of the stage and production equipment,

504
Tourism Development (MCE Sounds Limited) Order
(ii) informs the Ministry of Tourism, Investment, Creative
Industries, Culture and Information of any changes
relating to the approved tourism investment,
(iii) complies with —
(A) the reporting requirements of the Ministry of
Tourism, Investment, Creative Industries, Culture
and Information and the Department of Statistics
to assess the impact on the tourism sector and for
monitoring and compiling the Tourism Satellite
Account;
(B) the monitoring, licensing and certification
requirements of the Ministry of Tourism, Investment,
Creative Industries, Culture and Information and
any other agency of the Government.
Made this 21st day of August, 2025.
ERNEST HILAIRE,
Minister responsible for tourism.

505
Financial Services Regulatory Authority
(Amendment of Schedule 1) Order
SAINT LUCIA
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT, 2025, No. 125
[ 1st September, 2025 ]
In exercise of the power conferred under section 46 of the
Financial Services Regulatory Authority Act, Cap. 12.23, the Minister
responsible for finance makes this Order:
Citation
1. This Order may be cited as the Financial Services Regulatory
Authority (Amendment of Schedule 1) Order, 2025.
Amendment of Schedule 1
2. Schedule 1 of the Financial Services Regulatory Authority
Act, Cap. 12.23 is amended by inserting immediately after item 8 the
following new item 9 —
“9. Virtual Asset Business Act, Cap. 12.33”.
Made this 22nd day of August, 2025.
PHILIP J. PIERRE,
Minister responsible for finance.

Price Control (Amendment) (No. 12) Order
SAINT LUCIA
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT, 2025, No. 126
[ 1st September, 2025 ]
In exercise of the power conferred under section 29 of the
Distribution and Price of Goods Act, Cap. 13.09, the Minister
responsible for commerce makes this Order:
Citation and commencement
1.—(1) This Order may be cited as the Price Control (Amendment)
(No. 12) Order, 2025.
(2) This Order comes into force on the 1st day of September, 2025.
Amendment of Schedule
2. The Schedule of the Price Control Order, No. 54 of 2008 is
amended in section B —
(a) by deleting under the heading “Goods” all entries with
respect to Gasoline (unleaded) Diesel Oil, Kerosene
and Liquefied Propane Gas (LPG) (a) 20lb (9.07 kg)
cylinder (net contents), (b) 22lb (9.98 kg) cylinder (net
contents), (c) 100lb (45.36 kg) cylinder (net contents)
and (d) Bulk LPG (more than 100lbs or 45.36 kg) and
the corresponding maximum wholesale price and
maximum retail price; and
(b) by inserting under the heading “Goods” the goods
specified in the Schedule to this Order and the
corresponding maximum wholesale price and maximum
retail price.

Excise Tax (Amendment of Schedule 1) (No. 12) Order
SAINT LUCIA
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT, 2025, No. 127
[ 1st September, 2025 ]
In exercise of the power conferred under section 20 of the Excise
Tax Act, Cap. 15.07, the Minister responsible for finance makes this
Order:
Citation and commencement
1.—(1) This Order may be cited as the Excise Tax (Amendment of
Schedule 1) (No. 12) Order, 2025.
(2) This Order comes into force on the 1st day of September, 2025.
Amendment of Schedule
2. Schedule 1 to the Excise Tax Act, Cap. 15.07 is amended by
replacing the excise tax rates specified in column 3 for the HS numbers
specified in column 1 in relation to the goods specified in column 2
with the excise tax rates specified in column 3 of the Schedule to this
Order.

511
Immigration (Waiver of Fee for Extension of Permit) Order
SAINT LUCIA
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT, 2025, No. 128
[ 1st September, 2025 ]
In exercise of the power conferred under section 22A of the
Immigration Act, Cap. 10.01, the Minister responsible for immigration
matters makes this Order:
Citation
1. This Order may be cited as the Immigration (Waiver of Fee
for Extension of Permit) Order, 2025.
Waiver of fee for extension of permit
2.—(1) Subject to subsection (2), the fees that are due and payable
by the 30th day of June, 2026 for an extension of a permit granted
under section 12 of the Immigration Act, Cap. 10.01 are waived.
(2) A waiver of fees under subsection (1) applies to a citizen of a
member state of the Caribbean Community under section 5(5) of the
Immigration Act, Cap. 10.01.
Made this 28th day of August, 2025.
PHILIP J. PIERRE,
Minister responsible for
immigration matters.
